paragraphs.text: "We pray to Avacyn on high. On snow-white wings fearless you fly. Keep safe our souls. Keep safe our lives. May angels watch us from the skies." —Children's prayer
"Some aspire to climb the mountain of Honor. The Benalish are born upon its peak, and from there ascend among the stars." —*History of Benalia*
Vampires know blood and the systems that carry it. And they know exactly where to strike to set it free.
Benalish citizens born under the same constellations share a star-clan. Their loyalty to one another interlaces the Seven Houses.
"Undefeated in battle, she is the shining future our empire deserves." —Huatli
Rest sometimes requires the right prompting.
"For the lands you have lost and the beauty that remains, for freedom and the future, we must hold nothing back!" —Gideon Jura
"Our enemies will soon discover that we are not as meek as they had believed."
The unicorns of Sursi are a manifestation of Serra's joy and compassion. They frolic and dance like children, offering blessings to anyone they encounter.
The angel remembers her past lives like dreams. Her song held up meadows. Her blade drove back darkness. Her wings carried her across the ages.
The remnants of Innistrad's corrupted angelic hosts collapsed to form the Flight of Nightmares.
"Improvement is a consequence of practice." —Stitcher Geralf
Pray that it doesn't seek the safety of your lungs.
Six feet of earth muffled his cries.
"Like ribbons of wind and wisdom the coatls fly, twisting mystery into truth, shaping the clouds to suit their inscrutable will." —Huatli
"I don't need your mage-rings or your mana equations. I call, and the sea answers." —Keyta, rebel hydromancer
Progress comes at a price.
He grants endless wishes, as long as you always wish for a blade.
"I do as I please, little mortal. Do go on about your wishes, though—they amuse me to no end."
Vastly outnumbered, the Zendikari found creative ways to even the odds.
On Innistrad, Liliana embraced necromancy, honing her powers by practicing on scores of undead—and sometimes the living.
Grixis is a world where the only things found in abundance are death and decay. Corpses, whole or in part, are the standard currency among necromancers and demons.
"You were keen enough to sink your fangs into us, vampire! And now you're afraid of a few little nibbles?" —Udvil "Ratty" Ratlock
Life is such a fragile thing.
"There are so many of them. It seems they've just been waiting for someone to serve."
The Curse of Wandering leaves only hatred.
The dead who wander beyond the safety of the city crave only to spread their curse.
Some of the thallids that escaped into the fens of Urborg began emulating the Cabal's bloodsoaked rituals in their own peculiar way.
"Eldrazi? Ha! Try walking through Zulaport at night with your pockets full. Now *that's* dangerous."
"Want to sink a ship? Blow a hole in the hull. Want to kill a regisaur? Same answer." —Captain Brandis Thorn
"We sail. We plunder. Then we dance."
Goblins journey to the sacrificial peaks in pairs so that the rare survivor might be able to relate the details of the other's grisly demise.
"Zendikar is always angry, though I've never seen that anger so precisely directed." —Nablus, North Hada trapper
"Trying to stop it would be foolish. If you feel it coming—run!" —Sergeant Ryda
"Ready . . . uh . . . fire!"
"You are undeserving of the afterlife. You will never feel the God-Pharaoh's embrace."
The earth walks, strongest of all.
"There is no power too great to be used in the defense of our ancestral lands."
As patient and generous as life, as harsh and merciless as nature.
The evil inside the mountain pulsed at Nissa in a shock wave of madness.
"Forward! Until the horizon is ours!" —Khemses, charioteer
"In my downtime I used to paint the vistas. Now the vistas disappear faster than my downtime."
It cares more about preserving the herd's territory than about preserving itself.
Loyal to a fault, it anticipates its master's every need.
"It's the must-have gift for everyone on your list. Get one for yourself, too!" —Chammi, curio vendor
It wails of buried riches and the souls lost seeking them.
"Though the afterlife, the city, and even the God-Pharaoh himself were one great deception, the ideals championed by the gods remain true." —Djeru, former Tah-crop initiate
Each time it is sent to find a safe haven, it takes longer to return.
"I did not think I would understand the cold filigree creatures of this world, but they too are governed by the laws of nature." —Nissa Revane
Most of the constructs the renegades used against the Consulate weren't originally intended for combat. But some didn't require much modification.
